caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with four slender, curved legs and a rectangular top. The table is shown in a three-quarter view, with two sides visible, emphasizing its depth and structure. The top of the table is a medium brown color with a lighter beige trim around the edges. The body of the table has panel-like details on the visible sides, and the wood grain is visible throughout. The apron below the tabletop features a wavy, scalloped lower edge. The legs are long, gently curved outward, and taper down to narrow feet, each with a lighter accent at the upper section where it meets the body of the table. The background is plain and a light beige color, with no additional objects or details present.
title: Rectangular Table for Serving or Tea
